title: 第四章 乱世？
content_zh:
贾珩也不恼，淡淡一笑，说道：「先辈荣光已远，某虽不才，也愿追逐先辈之脚步，听说谢兄在箭术一道上颇有独到之处，谢兄若不弃，可在箭术之上指点在下一二，倘若有所进益，必感佩谢兄之教诲。」
谢百户想了下，嘿然一笑道：「这把刀，拿着，看到那边的木桩子了？若是劈砍得开，老子就将箭术倾囊而授，若是劈不开，也别说俺老谢不讲情面。」
说着，将刀递将过去。
蔡权低声道：「董老弟，不是说容易……怎麽还考较上了。」
董迁皱眉道：「我也不知，先看看吧。」
贾珩轻掂着手中的雁翎刀，这把刀大约有二十斤左右，如非前身打熬了一些力气，恐怕提起来都费劲。
挥舞了下，挽了个刀花。
只是一下，谢百户就是眯了眯眼，暗暗称奇，这宁荣二国公的后人，早已不堪大用，没想到还有这等人物？
贾珩并作两步，提刀跳斩，就见刀光如虹，向着木桩劈去。
「咔嚓！」
海碗粗细的木桩，被从中斩断，断面如镜，光可鉴人。
「真是一口好刀！」
贾珩脱口赞道，只觉胳膊发酸，这是他时常用剑，而少用刀之故，二者的发力方式还有许多不同。
谢百户站起身，笑道：「好本事，俺老谢倒是看走了眼。」
董迁笑道：「谢哥，你可别小瞧我这贾兄弟，方才在家中见他练剑，剑光如虹，风雨不透。」
谢百户脸上也带了几分笑意，道：「这木桩是栎木所制，原较一般木桩就要难劈，贾兄一击而断，不简单，手上有功夫。」
不仅是力气，还有技巧，行家一出手，就知有没有。
蔡权也在一旁笑着暖着气氛，说道：「走，这都到晌午了，先去吃饭吧。」
贾珩点了点头，随着谢百户一同进入屋内。
谢百户住得是三间瓦房，屋内还有一个荆钗布裙的妇人，三十岁模样，皮肤不太好，有着长期操劳的疲态，身旁还带着几个小孩儿。

一个虎头虎脑的小孩儿，正眼珠骨碌碌地看着生人，目光落在蔡权和贾珩手中提着的礼盒，目光闪亮，身后还有两个扎着麻花辫的小姑娘，怯生生地打量着生人。
「去将这些酒温了来。」谢百户一进厢房，就先上了炕，对着一旁的婆娘吩咐着。
那女人应了一声，这边蔡权，贾珩将酒肉递将过去。
不多时，众人就饮酒叙话。
谢百户唏嘘道：「金人在北方何以年年掳掠，就是骑射废弛，遥想太祖之时，京营还能追亡逐北，这才多少年的功夫，军中还有多少人会骑射功夫？」
因为陈汉承明，自然也面临了如前明一样的问题，外有草原边患，内有地主阶级的土地兼并以及士绅为代言人的庞大文官集团。
贾珩沉吟道：「现在九边是什麽个情形？」
「还能是什麽情形？东虏势大难制，蓟镇总兵龟缩不出，北平府常年被掠，边疆百姓苦不堪言。」谢百户面色愤愤说道。
贾珩面上现出一抹思索，红楼梦世界到了后面，无疑就是一方改朝换代的乱世，正如《好了歌》所言，训有方，保不定日后作强梁，说的就是柳湘莲一干人，什麽样的时代，才会让柳湘莲一干人去作强梁。
除却乱世，不作他想。
《红楼梦》中第一回有载，甄士隐家宅被烧一空，其去田庄避居，书中道：「偏值今年水旱不收，贼盗蜂起，官兵剿捕……」
五十三回更有记载，乌进孝禀告，「今年年成实在不好，从三月下雨，接连直到八月，竟没有一连晴过五日，九月里一场碗大的雹子……」
念及此处，贾珩心中也不由生出几分凛然。
莫非是晚明的小冰河时期？
若是这般，仅仅科举入仕，并不足以在这方世界安身立命，还是需得兵权在手，才能于此方世界活得滋润。
这边厢，几人说着话，那边热好的酒菜，摆上桌子，众人边说边叙着话，从军中见闻提到京中琐事。
一场酒会，宾主尽欢，直到午后未时方止。
贾珩和谢再义约好了时间来学骑射，扶着喝得脸颊酡红的董丶蔡二人，相伴回家去了。
回来时，自是少了得被蔡氏一同埋冤，贾珩回到里屋睡觉，一直到黄昏时分，才方止。
准备了些热水，洗去了自身酒气，换了一身清洁衣衫。

正要来到书房就读，忽地看到蔡氏站在门槛处，似是欲言又止。
贾珩笑道：「蔡婶有话教我？」
蔡氏一家三口，他家虽贫寒，其实还有一二十亩地，由蔡氏的丈夫以及蔡兄一家三口耕种着。
蔡氏道：「婶子却有几句话要嘱托珩哥儿。」
说着，走进屋里。
贾珩笑了笑，提起一旁的茶壶，给蔡氏倒来一杯茶，转身给说道：「蔡婶儿，您喝茶。」
蔡氏坐在桌子上，笑道：「哥儿是愈发像个大人了。」
贾珩笑了笑，说道：「穷人家的孩子早当家罢了，蔡婶也算是看我长大的。」
蔡氏捧着茶，笑着感慨道：「若是姑娘还在，不定心里多慰贴呢。」
贾珩叹了一口气，道：「娘她操劳一辈子，也没跟着我父子享过一天福，哎……」
蔡氏就是沉默，片刻后，忽道：「姑娘就希望哥儿读书进学，临走之前，其实，给哥儿定了一门亲事。」
贾珩讶异道：「亲事？」
蔡氏道：「这是婚书，原是早定下来的。」
说着，从袖笼中取过一个木盒，梨花木的盒子做工精致，上面镂着凤凰花纹。
贾珩面色顿了下，伸手接过，
「秦业之女？秦可卿？」贾珩脸色就有几分古怪之意。
秦可卿不是要嫁给贾蓉吗？
也是，此刻的贾蓉年岁刚刚十六，应未娶亲才是。
「只是，以我如今之穷措大的身份，秦业说不得会退婚，我难道还要整个三年之约？」贾珩看着婚书，一时现出凝思。
当然，就算秦业应允下来，秦可卿这种绝色尤物，他若无一些本事，也根本保不住。

红颜祸水，并非虚言。
但让他置之不理，若是秦可卿如原着嫁给贾蓉，再被贾珍那老东西扒灰，好像又……挺膈应的。
「我下午时已让你叔采买一些礼物，明日，你去秦家和秦家人，商定一下婚期。」蔡氏道。
贾珩沉吟了下，道：「蔡婶，我们自家人知自家事，我家这般情况，他秦家多半是要反悔的，我们上门岂不是自讨没趣。」
蔡氏笑道：「哥儿有所不知，这是当年秦业应允过的，岂会反悔，哥儿明日只管去，那时自有计较。」
贾珩不知蔡氏为何如此笃定，不过见其神情期冀，暂且答应了下来。

content_en:
Jia Heng was not annoyed and smiled lightly and said: "The glory of our ancestors is far away. Although I am not talented, I am still willing to follow in the footsteps of my ancestors. I heard that Brother Xie is quite unique in the art of archery. If Brother Xie does not give up, he can give you some pointers on the art of archery. If there is any improvement, I will thank you for your teachings."
Xie Baihu thought for a moment, then smiled and said: "Here is this knife, do you see the wooden stake over there? If you can chop it open, I will teach you the art of archery. If you can't chop it, don't say that I am ungrateful."
As he said that, he handed the knife over.
Cai Quan whispered: "Brother Dong, it's not easy...how come you still pass the exam?"
Dong Qian frowned and said, "I don't know either, let's take a look first."
Jia Heng weighed the Yanling Knife in his hand. The knife weighed about twenty kilograms. If it hadn't been for some effort from his predecessor, it would have been difficult to lift it.
He waved his hand and made a sword.
Just for a moment, Xie Baihu squinted his eyes and secretly marveled. The descendants of Ning Rong, Duke of the Second Kingdom, have long been of no use. He didn't expect such a person to exist?
Jia Heng took two steps together, raised his sword and struck with a leap. He saw the sword's light flashing like a rainbow, slashing towards the wooden stake.
"Crack!"
A wooden stake as thick as a sea bowl is cut off from the middle. The cross section is like a mirror, and the light can be used to discern people.
"What a great knife!"
Jia Heng praised it out loud and felt his arms were sore. This was because he often used swords and rarely used knives. There are many differences in the way they exert force.
Xie Baihu stood up and said with a smile: "What a great skill, but I, Lao Xie, missed it."
Dong Qian smiled and said, "Brother Xie, don't underestimate me, brother Jia. I just saw him practicing swordsmanship at home. The sword was as bright as a rainbow, and it was impervious to wind and rain."
Xie Baihu also had a smile on his face and said: "This wooden stake is made of oak. It is more difficult to break than ordinary wooden stakes. Brother Jia broke it with one blow. It was not easy. He has good skills."
Not only strength, but also skill, an expert will know if it is there as soon as he takes action.
Cai Quan also smiled and warmed up the atmosphere and said, "Let's go, it's already noon, let's go eat first."
Jia Heng nodded and followed Xie Baihu into the house.
Xie Baihu lives in a three-room tile-roofed house. There is also a woman in Jingchai and sarong in the house. She looks like thirty years old, her skin is not good, she is tired from long-term work, and she has several children beside her.
A tiger-headed child was looking at the stranger with thick eyes. His eyes fell on the gift boxes held by Cai Quan and Jia Heng. His eyes were shining. Behind him were two little girls with braids, looking timidly at the stranger.
"Go and warm up these wines." As soon as Xie Baihu entered the wing, he got on the kang and ordered the mother-in-law beside him.
The woman responded, and Cai Quan and Jia Heng handed over the wine and meat.
After a while, everyone was drinking and talking.
Xie Baihu sighed and said: "Why are the Jin people in the north plundering every year? They just use cavalry and archery. I think back to the time of Taizu, when the capital camp was still chasing people to the north. How many years of kung fu have it been? How many people in the army still know how to ride and shoot?"
Because Chen Hancheng Ming naturally faced the same problems as the previous Ming Dynasty, there were grassland border dangers externally, land annexation by the landlord class internally, and a huge civil servant group with gentry as spokesperson.
Jia Heng pondered: "What's the situation in Jiubian now?"
"What else could it be like? The situation of the Eastern Han Dynasty is in great difficulty. The general soldiers of Ji Town are unable to retreat, Beiping Mansion has been looted all the year round, and the people on the border are miserable." Xie Baihu said with an indignant look.
There was a trace of thought on Jia Heng's face. The world of Dream of Red Mansions will undoubtedly be a troubled time of changing dynasties. As "Good Song" said, if you train well, you can't guarantee that you will be a strong leader in the future. He is talking about Liu Xianglian and others. What kind of era will allow Liu Xianglian and others to be strong leaders.
Except for the troubled times, don’t think about other things.
In the first chapter of "A Dream of Red Mansions", it is recorded that Zhen Shiyin's house was burned down and he went to the farm to take refuge. The book said: "This year coincided with floods and droughts and no harvest, thieves and thieves appeared in droves, and officers and soldiers hunted down..."
fiftyThere are more records in three chapters. Wu Jinxiao reported, "This year's harvest is really bad. It rained continuously from March until August, and it didn't have sunny days for five consecutive days. In September, there was a hailstorm as big as a bowl..."
Thinking of this, Jia Heng couldn't help but feel a little awe-inspiring in his heart.
Could it be the Little Ice Age in the late Ming Dynasty?
If this is the case, just passing the imperial examination and becoming an official is not enough to settle down in this world. You still need to have military power in order to live a prosperous life in this world.
On one side of the room, several people were talking. On the other side, the heated food and wine were placed on the table. Everyone talked and talked, talking about what they had seen in the army and mentioning trivial matters in the capital.
At a cocktail party, the guests and hosts enjoyed themselves until late afternoon.
Jia Heng and Xie Zaiyi made an appointment to learn riding and shooting. They supported Dong and Cai, whose cheeks were red from drinking, and went home together.
When he came back, it was rare that he had to bury his injustice with Cai, so Jia Heng went back to the back room to sleep until dusk.
I prepared some hot water, washed away the smell of alcohol, and changed into clean clothes.
Just as he was about to come to the study to study, he suddenly saw Mrs. Cai standing at the threshold, seemingly hesitant to speak.
Jia Heng smiled and said, "Aunt Cai has something to teach me?"
There are three members of Cai's family. Although his family is poor, they actually have ten or twenty acres of land, which is cultivated by Cai's husband and brother Cai's family.
Ms. Cai said, "Auntie has a few words for Brother Heng."
With that said, he walked into the house.
Jia Heng smiled, picked up the teapot on the side, poured a cup of tea for Mrs. Cai, turned around and said, "Aunt Cai, drink tea."
Mr. Cai sat on the table and said with a smile, "Brother is becoming more and more like an adult."
Jia Heng smiled and said, "Children from poor families have long been in charge, and Aunt Cai has watched me grow up."
Mrs. Cai held the tea, smiled and said with emotion: "If the girl is still here, I may feel so relieved."
Jia Heng sighed and said, "My mother has worked hard all her life, but she has never enjoyed a single day of happiness with my father and son. Alas..."
Mrs. Cai was silent. After a moment, she suddenly said: "The girl hopes that my brother will study and go to school. Before leaving, she actually made a marriage arrangement for him."
Jia Heng said in surprise: "Marriage?"
Ms. Cai said, "This is the marriage certificate. It was decided long ago."
As he said that, he took out a wooden box from the armhole. The pear wood box was exquisitely made, with a phoenix pattern engraved on it.
Jia Heng's expression paused, and he reached out to take it.
"Qin Ye's daughter? Qin Keqing?" Jia Heng's face looked a little strange.
Isn't Qin Keqing going to marry Jia Rong?
Also, Jia Rong is just sixteen years old at the moment and should not be married.
"It's just that with my current poor status, Qin Ye can't possibly break off the engagement. Do I still want to keep the entire three-year contract?" Jia Heng looked at the marriage letter and looked thoughtful for a moment.
Of course, even if Qin Ye agreed, he wouldn't be able to keep a stunning beauty like Qin Keqing if he didn't have some skills.
It is no lie that beauty brings disaster.
But let him ignore it. If Qin Keqing married Jia Rong as originally written, and then was stripped of her ashes by that old guy Jia Zhen, it would seem... quite uncomfortable.
"I asked your uncle to buy some gifts in the afternoon. Tomorrow, you go to the Qin family and discuss the wedding date with the Qin family." Cai said.
Jia Heng pondered for a moment and said, "Aunt Cai, our family knows our own affairs. If my family is in such a situation, the Qin family will probably regret it. If we come here, we are asking for trouble."
Cai laughed and said, "Brother, I don't know. This is what Qin Ye promised back then. How can he regret it? I'll just go tomorrow. I'll have my own thoughts then."
Jia Heng didn't know why Cai was so determined, but seeing his hopeful expression, he agreed temporarily.
